document.about: One invented page (fixtures/field-list-colons.py): a report's header block of bold labels over plain values; a product's fields in one plain face, every other value set 0.02 pt above its label; and two things that are no field list, a chart's NOTE and SOURCE and paragraphs that open on a label and wrap under it.

notes: Remake with: python3 eval/tough/fixtures/field-list-colons.py, then update the sha256.

2026-11-24: the header block came out as a table of its first two rows, the two with figures, then `Prepared by:` and `Status:` as headings and `J. Example` as a heading of its own. The product's labels and values were read as two columns of text, every label apart from its value (#9).

checks.issue: The rows without figures fell out of the table, label and value each a paragraph.
`J. Example`, an initial and a name, was taken for a lettered heading.
A value set a hair above its label was read ahead of it, the row as one cell, and the list as two columns of text.
Read as a table, the first field was its header: every value under `Polypropylene`.
A NOTE and SOURCE whose values are sentences is a caption.
As above, read with the NOTE as its header row.
Paragraphs opening on a label whose last value wraps under the labels are no field list.
As above, read with the first as its header row.
